YOUR FIELD NOTES

How to be an explorer

  1. Read the map key. Each icon stands for a kind of place. The same icons appear on the island and in your clues.
  2. Solve the clue. Tap the marker that matches. Some clues ask you to compare nearby places.
  3. Follow the paths. Plan every stop along the dotted paths, then press Walk route. Pick up supplies at a camp: rope for mountains, a lantern for caves, and a boat for lagoons. Avoid marshes.
  4. Find the treasure. Finish five missions on each island. Hunt optional relics, then sail onward. Replay generates fresh maps.

North is up, east is right. “Beside” means connected by a dotted path.
